en: Black‑and‑white photograph showing a large stone castle with steep multi‑gabled roofs and a small spire, standing on a rocky outcrop above a river valley thickly covered with trees. Below the castle there is an industrial complex with multi‑story factory buildings and a cylindrical tower, and a covered wooden bridge crossing a fast‑flowing river with a weir. In the far background, on a wooded hill, another building with a tall church‑like spire is visible. No text is visible on the image.
